label: Whatever is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1
paraphrase: Open sense bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever is INFINITE_1 and comprehended by no intellect whose being some other being causes (INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2) is known by no created intellect as perfectly as it is knowable (INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1, the primitive Primitives.Incomprehensible). After ST I q.12 a.7. It carries what INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 leaves untyped: that the primitive Comprehends is knowing as perfectly as knowable, and that every created intellect (from nothing) is among the caused intellects. Both sides negate comprehension only, so neither conflicts with the cataphatic teaching that God can be known with certainty by natural reason (Dei Filius ch. 2, DS 3004); a radically apophatic thesis (God is not known at all) is stronger than either side and is not a premise here. Strictly weaker than 'Whatever is INFINITE_1 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1' (its antecedent adds that no caused intellect comprehends g; Control part 3: an infinite being comprehended by a caused intellect satisfies this bridge vacuously and falsifies the old one).
